ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of fraud in Minnesota and examine the extent of the problem.
questions: What is the total amount of money lost to fraud in Minnesota?
How many individuals have been charged with fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale problem with significant financial implications. By following the money and examining the recent cases of fraud in Minnesota, we can gain a better understanding of the extent of the problem and identify potential solutions.
